audit_note: 2026-11-08: Vijay switched an API-uploaded video to Public in Studio and it worked, so Approve uploads straight to YouTube as private again. If Google ever emails that a video is locked private, set this back to false (posting kit).

global.why: 07:30 IST is the Shorts morning scroll in India and 9 pm the night before on the US East Coast. 18:30 IST catches the India evening and US breakfast. Reels peak in the evening, so 19:30 IST for India, 07:30 IST for US night owls.

india.why: India-first: Shorts do best on the morning commute (08:00) and after work (19:00). Reels peak 7 to 11 pm local.

schedule.note: Starting points from 2026 timing studies (Buffer, SocialPilot): Shorts lean morning, Reels lean weekday evening, studies disagree, so the engine rotates windows and the analytics decide later.
